phase: bounded source/value gate before selecting numerical analysis
question: Do public EMC physiological measurements or untreated serial metastatic trajectories support a useful new phenotype beyond published indolence and lineage observations?

queries: extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma hypoglycemia IGF2 glucose lactate metabolic metabolomics Cushing ACTH secretion
prespecified_candidates.necessary_observations: Authenticated EMC case/model, actual physiological measurement with treatment timing and interpretable comparator or within-person intervention; no RNA proxy for metabolite or secretion
prespecified_candidates.use: Identify a clinically measurable EMC state or a specific reproducible next measurement absent from primary prior art

queries: extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma doubling time growth rate untreated observation spontaneous regression pulmonary metastases
prespecified_candidates.necessary_observations: Explicit EMC identity and all identifiable case-linked serial lesion sizes with dates and no intervening treatment; independent donors or informative controlled contrast
prespecified_candidates.use: Quantify untreated trajectory as a possible response/monitoring comparator beyond known long survival

strongest_alternatives: Selection of unusually indolent case reports
Already established phenotype; recovering authors measurements is not discovery
Disease identity error or reused donor
defeat_criteria: No authenticated numerical measurements with eligible temporal or comparator linkage
Only previously established measurements and no useful unanswered comparison
Suitable accessible evidence remaining unevaluated blocks promotion
One unusual case without disease-relevant generalizability or actionable new measurement is not a standalone finding
stop: At 25 minutes stop source gate; disposition routes separately. If a genuinely discriminating small computation is suitable, append a numerical pilot contract before inspecting additional values. Otherwise shelve standalone paper with exact missing evidence/reopening condition. Leave source gaps explicit. Independent round6 challenge remains separate when lead packet arrives.
